name: pau-profiler
description: Local-first context utilization analysis for AI agents: Context Hog detection, uncertainty intervals, evictable-load estimation, trace comparison, optimization planning, and CI budget enforcement using Pig Adjustable Units (PAU).

scripts.example: npm run build && node bin/pau.mjs analyze examples/research-agent.json
scripts.example:series: npm run build && node bin/pau.mjs series examples/series/turn-1.json examples/series/turn-2.json examples/series/turn-3.json examples/series/turn-4.json
scripts.example:report: npm run build && node bin/pau.mjs report examples/research-agent.json --tier developer
